hook.name: MasterLaunchHookC
hook.description: An ownerless Uniswap v4 token launch hook with all 14 permission flags. Manages fees via a dynamic hook tax, anti-snipe time-decay tax, and plugin surcharges; intercepts sells at or below the backed floor price; enforces per-block same-origin MEV cooldowns; and routes callbacks through an extensible plugin system for revenue distribution, intent settlement, and burn/deepen queues.
